title: config-service: add tenant-aware diff endpoint w/ authz + redaction hooks
author: Benji Okafor
release_notes:
- Internal API: add config diff endpoint intended for incident-bot v2 and Console deep links
- Adds redaction hooks and response size guardrails
- Enforces tenant-aware authorization (no cross-tenant diffs; least-privilege scopes)
body:
Summary
Adds a new internal config diff endpoint to config-service for Incident Bot v2 and Console diagnostics.

Motivation
During incidents we need a fast, tenant-safe way to answer: “what changed in config recently?” without SSHing into nodes or grepping ad-hoc logs. This PR introduces a first-class, audited-by-design diff path that:
- is tenant-aware (explicit tenant context; no implicit globals)
- enforces least-privilege authz (service scopes + on-call break-glass role handled by the auth gateway)
- supports redaction hooks so callers can render safe output in Slack

API
- POST /internal/config/v1/diff
- Request fields: tenant_id (required), environment (required), scope (one of: tenant|region|service), target (e.g. region=eu-west-1, service=hosted-api), from_version (optional), to_version (optional), from_time/to_time (optional, max window enforced), options (format + limits)
- Response fields: from_version, to_version, change_count, truncated (bool), redaction_summary, diff (structured)

Important constraints / guardrails
- Window limit: max 24h lookback when using time range; max 50 versions when using version range.
- Payload size limit: response capped at 256KB; when exceeded, sets truncated=true and includes a stable “top changes” summary.
- No secret values returned: redaction layer runs before serialization; value-level masking is default; allowlist-based pass-through only for explicitly safe keys.
- Deterministic output: stable ordering of diff entries for caching and Slack card rendering.

AuthZ model
- Requires service identity with scope: config.diff:read
- Tenant boundary enforced in config-service by validating tenant_id against caller claims (tenant set intersection) from the internal auth context.
- Adds an explicit “reason” string in request context (propagated from caller) to support audit events in follow-up wiring; this PR stores it in request logs and returns 400 if missing for non-human callers.

Redaction model
This PR adds a redaction interface + default rules, and returns a redaction_summary so incident-bot can display “N fields redacted” messaging.
- Default: redact all values for keys matching secret patterns (token, key, password, secret, private_key, auth_header, cookie, bearer, kms, s3_access_key, etc.)
- Additional patterns: entropy-based detector on string values (base64-ish / high entropy) with conservative thresholds
- Safe allowlist (value may be returned as-is): routing.policy.variant, routing.fallback.enabled, quota.*.limit, rate_limit.*.enabled, model_pins.*, feature_flags.* (values still masked if they look like secrets)
- For non-allowlisted keys: return key + “(redacted)” marker; never return raw value

Implementation notes
- Introduces ConfigHistoryStore#Diff(from,to,filters) backed by existing versioned snapshots in config-store (no new persistence introduced).
- Adds DiffRenderer that produces a structured diff (op: add|remove|change, path, old_value, new_value, metadata).
- Hooks: Redactor interface runs over DiffEntry prior to rendering; caller can request “render=summary” or “render=full” but both apply the same redaction.
- Pagination: not added (yet). Instead, response is truncated + summary to fit Slack and to keep query cost bounded.

Testing
- Unit tests: tenant boundary enforcement, scope checks, redaction patterns (including regression tests for known leak paths), stable ordering
- Integration tests: snapshot diff across version range, truncation behavior, 24h window enforcement

Rollout plan
- Dark launch behind config-service flag: internal.config_diff_endpoint_enabled (default off)
- Incident-bot will be pointed at this endpoint only for the SRE beta cohort once enabled

Docs / references
- Implements part of ENG-5422 (diff retrieval + redaction hooks)
- Permission model aligns with ENG-5426; audit event emission is in a follow-up (see notes in reviewer thread)

Notes / follow-ups
- Emit formal audit events for each diff call (separate PR to central audit pipeline)
- Add cursor-based pagination for Console use cases (if needed)
- Add per-tenant rate limits at the gateway once call volume is understood

Checklist
- [x] Tenant boundary tests
- [x] Redaction tests incl. “never return raw secret-like values”
- [x] Response truncation guardrail
- [x] Internal docs updated (README + endpoint comment block)
- [ ] Audit event emission (follow-up)

Screens / examples
Example truncated response (render=summary):
- routing.fallback.enabled: false -> true
- feature_flags.incident_bot_v2: 0% -> 10%
- quota.tokens_per_minute.limit: 120000 -> 90000
- model_pins.chat.default: rw-open-llama-3-8b@2025-02-01 -> rw-open-llama-3-8b@2025-02-10
(redaction_summary: 3 fields redacted)


Commits
1) config-service: add DiffRequest/DiffResponse types + routing
2) authz: enforce config.diff:read and tenant claim intersection
3) diff: add history store diff + stable ordering
4) redaction: add Redactor interface + default secret patterns
5) tests: add unit + integration coverage + truncation cases
6) docs: internal endpoint docs + examples

Changed areas (high level)
- services/config-service/src/http/routes/internal_diff.ts
- services/config-service/src/diff/diff_engine.ts
- services/config-service/src/diff/redaction/default_redactor.ts
- services/config-service/src/auth/authorize.ts
- services/config-service/test/diff_redaction.test.ts
- services/config-service/test/diff_authz.test.ts


Review conversation (highlights)

Ethan Park (requested changes): “Need explicit response size guardrails; Slack rendering will explode otherwise. Also ensure time-range queries are bounded.”
Benji Okafor: “Added 256KB cap + truncated=true with top-changes summary. Enforced max 24h lookback and max 50 versions.”

Kaitlyn Nguyen (requested changes): “Tenant intersection check should be done in-service, not only at gateway. Also require a ‘reason’ for non-human callers to support auditing.”
Benji Okafor: “Added in-service tenant claim intersection check. Added required reason field for service identities and logged it into request context.”

Marcus Lin (comment): “Entropy detector can false-positive; ensure allowlist keys still get masked if they match secret patterns.”
Benji Okafor: “Updated redactor: allowlist permits value passthrough only if it fails secret-pattern + entropy checks; otherwise masked.”

Kevin Osei (comment): “We’ll need audit events for compliance; ok to land hooks now but please leave a clear TODO + interface point.”
Benji Okafor: “Added AuditContext struct in request handling and a hook point (no-op impl) so follow-up can emit events to SIEM pipeline.”

Mina Haddad (approval): “Diff schema looks good for incident routing policy diagnosis. Thanks for stable ordering; makes caching possible.”

Approvals
- Kaitlyn Nguyen: Approved
- Ethan Park: Approved
- Marcus Lin: Approved
- Kevin Osei: Approved

CI
- build-and-unit-tests: PASS
- lint: PASS
- integration-tests (config-service): PASS
- security-scan: PASS

Merge
Squash merged into main. Post-merge note: feature flag remains off in prod pending incident-bot beta enablement.
